voice: Sharp, honest, confident, curated, clever. Dry and plain; price and condition do the selling.
philosophy: Product first and honest: the actual item, its real condition, its price. Clean, sharp, uncluttered.
visual_philosophy: Clean product photography on a dark or neutral background, product 60 to 70% of frame, lighting that makes condition visible. Colours and fonts are UNCONFIRMED (repo, workbook and live site disagree): do not pick a palette until the designer's files arrive.
composition_rules: Product centred, 60 to 70% of the frame
Logo top-left on feed, top-right on Stories
DROP stamp or SOLD overlay in the top or bottom third, never covering the product face
Condition visible: face, sole, crown, shaft and grip shots for a condition check
anti_patterns: Golf course, outdoor grass, country club or cluttered workshop backgrounds
Retouching that hides wear or makes a graded item look better than it is
Model-rendered text, prices, specs or logos
Rendered products, rendered venues or fake SOLD proof
people_policy: Mostly no people. When a person appears: hands holding a club for scale, never stock-model smiles.

lean_toward: the actual product on a clean background
close-ups of face, sole and crown
packed parcel for OUT THE DOOR (real sales only)
